spec2def(bcrypt.dll bcrypt.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# bcrypt.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/bcrypt-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(bcrypt_shims OBJECT bcrypt_main.c)
target_link_libraries(bcrypt_shims PRIVATE wine symcrypt libmbedtls libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(bcrypt_shims)
add_cargo_module(bcrypt bcrypt-cargo bcrypt.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS bcrypt_shims psdk)
